source: Existing cafe strategy evidence in research/report.html and native/CodexCafeRange.cs; exact original parity unverified
hypothesis: Frozen OR-retest and failed-IB rules may have positive after-cost expectancy; currently only 1-4 development trades
rules: Preserve installed CodexCafeRange Variant 2 RangeMinutes 15/30 and Variant 3 RangeMinutes 15 (internally fixed IB60); no parameter tuning

data_requirements.type: Last ticks plus complete 5-minute RTH bars
data_requirements.target: 60 complete sessions if available without payment; continue prospective accumulation otherwise
data_requirements.regimes: Report daily range and volatility coverage descriptively; no claim all regimes represented

expected_frequency.basis: Observed development only, not future guarantee
expected_frequency.implication: 60 sessions can still leave rare retests inconclusive; no universal trade-count pass

metrics: net excluding best 1 and 3 positive trades
session-block uncertainty when enough distinct sessions
closed and path drawdown reported separately
risk: Keep existing NQ-only one-contract, $300 entry risk cap and historical-only guard; no live orders, no risk expansion

search_budget.data_acquisition: existing permitted account only; no purchase

chronological_split.reason: Acquired after selection but precedes already-observed Oct19-22; not pristine chronological OOS
chronological_split.known_observed: Sep29-Oct6 and Oct19-22; never reuse as independent OOS
chronological_split.future: Reserve later unseen dates before opening results; prospective paper validation separately

coverage_policy.retest: Rare event: continue gathering sessions; report active-session ratio and concentration; positive few trades remains deferred
coverage_policy.failedIB: Higher observed frequency: same distinct-session audit; compare daily net and session dependence
coverage_policy.uncertainty: Below 60 distinct complete sessions report insufficient coverage; at 60+ assess daily dependence, session-block sensitivity and confidence interval. No promotion solely from count or positive net; uncertainty crossing zero remains deferred
coverage_policy.pre_registration_limit: This policy is prospective for extension, not represented as preregistration of the already completed runs

stop_policy: Stop current batch on corrupt data, native errors, source/hash changes or duplicate fingerprint. Negative observed net is sample failure, not permanent discard. Data unavailable: retain exact blocker and restart condition, proceed to other feasible candidate. Only eligible candidates progress to order/fill Replay, then new-data simulated forward test.
